name: Sea Palms Private Beachfront Estate
insider_take: This exclusive beachfront sanctuary sits on one of Florida's most pristine barrier islands, where shelling is world-class and sunsets paint the Gulf of Mexico in brilliant oranges and pinks every evening.
whats_special: Sea Palms offers ultra-private luxury on car-free Captiva Island, accessible only by boat or causeway. The estate features direct access to some of the world's best shelling beaches, where rare Junonia and Lion's Paw shells wash ashore. As part of Marriott's elite STARS program, guests enjoy personalized service typically reserved for heads of state and celebrities.
pro_tip: Visit during new moon phases for the best shelling conditions, and book sunset dolphin watching tours directly from the property's private dock for an unforgettable experience.
dont_miss: The legendary sunsets at Blind Pass Beach, world-renowned shelling at Bowman's Beach, and a visit to the historic Captiva Chapel by the Sea. The nearby J.N. "Ding" Darling National Wildlife Refuge offers incredible bird watching and kayaking through pristine mangrove tunnels.
pros: Exclusive private beachfront estate offering unparalleled privacy and luxury
Prime Captiva Island location with direct beach access and stunning Gulf views
Marriott STARS Program benefits including VIP amenities and personalized service
Spacious estate-style accommodations ideal for families and groups
cons: Remote island location requires advance planning for dining and activities
Ultra-luxury pricing reflects exclusive estate experience
This property is not available for online booking.
